items.title: Roy Carew Interview, 1964-11-28
items.q: I, that, that one with Dodds, that was very fine. I, I liked that, yeah.

ctx.x: Well, you mean you sent him to Lomax?

Yeah, I sent him to Lomax. And he put him in. I have a manuscript of the Naked Dance, you know. I had to make it, yes. Wonderful extra chorus that he puts on there, at least in my estimation it is. Well that was for piano alone, not score. Just for piano. That's right. Yeah. Because he could do that with almost any piece of chorus, Johnny could. That's the remarkable thing about him. And as I say, when he was here in Washington and making those records that finally got put out by jazz man on the west coast, I…
